output.reason: [ev-274ce3859ab9] only states that the istiod-remote chart was removed in favor of `helm install istio-discovery --set profile=remote`; it does not say what happens to an existing istiod-remote installation if the operator does nothing, nor that a migration step is mandatory "before upgrading to 1.24.0" as the proposed statement claims. The two proposals disagree (P1 marks the consequence undetermined) and every validator was inconclusive, so a mandatory-work kind would be over-claiming. Missing: upgrade-guide or migration notes for 1.24.0 that describe the effect on existing istiod-remote releases and whether moving to istio-discovery with profile=remote is a required step.
